_README: Source of truth for which MPMB mechanical capabilities THIS sheet implements. supported: true|false. status 'auto-*' means the value was guessed by probing index.html -- review and set it explicitly, then it won't be overwritten. Re-run the oracle after each build.

action.note: Action Economy card on the Features page: renderActionEconomy() sorts the character's features into Action / Bonus Action / Reaction columns, derived from the feature prose (combat reference). Weapon attacks stay in the Attacks table; spell casting-times not classified.

addTo.note: no routing of bonus spells to another feature

adv_vs.note: same scanDefenses save-advantage path; 'Adv. on saves vs. X' lines

advantages.note: PARTIAL: save-type advantages now auto-applied via scanDefenses; ability-check & attack-roll advantages still manual

amendTo.note: features appended as standalone blocks, no amend

ammoAdd.note: ammo is inert consumable, no tracking

calcChanges.note: hp hook: hpFeatureBonus() adds Tough (+2/lvl), Dwarven Toughness/Hill Dwarf (+1/lvl), Draconic Resilience (+1/sorcerer lvl) into Max HP (box + wizard + HP panel). atkCalc/atkAdd (weapons): attackRiders() appends class/feat riders to attack damage cells (Sneak Attack, Rage, Improved Divine Smite, Great Weapon Fighting reroll, Improved/Superior Critical crit range, Brutal Critical + Savage Attacks crit dice). atkCalc/spellAdd (spells): the Spells page now has an auto-computed Damage column (spell.dmg baked from 5etools: cantrip scalingLevelDice → dice at character level, leveled spells → base {@damage} dice + damageInflict type; refreshSpellDamageCells() keeps it live), and spellDamageAdds() folds in Empowered Evocation (+Int to wizard evocation), Potent Spellcasting (+Wis to cleric cantrips), Agonizing Blast (+Cha to Eldritch Blast), and Elemental Affinity (+Cha to a draconic sorcerer's element). Already covered elsewhere: magic-weapon riders (Flame Tongue/Frost Brand/Dragon Slayer/Holy Avenger… via magicWeapons+weaponAtkRow), Archery/Dueling/Thrown/Great Weapon fighting styles, Martial Arts, ability subs, and spellCalc items (Robe of the Archmagi/Staff of Power → spellItemBonus). Remaining spellAdd cases are cosmetic component/description tweaks (Archdruid no-components, Disciple of Life healing text).

carryingCapacity.note: Powerful Build / Equine Build / Little Giant (race traits) + Bear Totem Barbarian (Aspect of the Beast: Bear) → carryMultiplier() doubles carry, push/drag/lift, and variant enc thresholds

featsAdd.note: feat profs/senses applied; class-granted feats in createCharacter

feature.note: features looked up by name; conditional opt filtering

fixedDC.note: itemFixedDC() pulls the item-printed save DC ("…(save 13)…") from baked item text and shows it on the equipped item Limited Features row ("Eyes of Charming (save DC 13)"), making clear the DC is fixed, not ability-derived; covers the charged save-DC items (the trackable bulk). Edges: at-will items with no Limited Features home (crystal ball, blast scepter) and save-less/text-less items have no DC surface.

fixedSpAttack.note: only additive item bonus; no fixed override

hpForceRecalc.note: compute() recalcs maxHP on Con/hitdice change

magicitemsAdd.note: AC + spell-bonus items auto-apply (partial: not all items)

note.note: feature f.text auto-rendered to Features page

origin.note: source '(Class N)' appended to feature line

savetxt.note: scanDefenses() now extracts save (dis)advantages from race traits (applyRace) and class/feat features (genDefenses) -> #defnotes; both 2014 & 2024 phrasings

skillstxt.note: skill-proficiency choices are applied via the builder: class skill choices (wiz-skills picker -> committed to skp- boxes in createCharacter), race skill choices (rc-skillchoose), and now skill-granting feats (FEAT_SKILLS: Skilled +3, Skill Expert +1, Prodigy +1, Squat Nimbleness from Acro/Athletics -> featSkillPicker, applied idempotently by applyAsiBonuses, persisted in asiChoices.featSkills). The 18-skill section's Prof/Exp checkboxes cover anything else (Expertise selection, Lore Bard's bonus proficiencies) which surface as feature-text reminders.

spellChanges.note: SPELL_CHANGES registry (hand-coded, survives rebake) of source->spell overrides for the authored class/race/invocation cases (Warlock invocations Armor of Shadows/Ascendant Step/Chains of Carceri/Fiendish Vigor/Misty Visions/Otherworldly Leap, Monk Empty Body, Tiefling Infernal Legacy). scFor() matches a source present in the Features text or chosen optional features; the spell's displayed casting time/range/components/material are overridden and a 'Changed:' note is appended to the tooltip, with a sc-changed accent marker. Applied in both propCells (full render) and the in-place sp-name typing handler. N/A by sheet design: item-granted spell changes (43 item blocks) -- magic-item spells aren't auto-populated onto the spell sheet.

spellcastingBonus.note: alwaysPreparedNames/characterExpandedSpells route domain & subclass spells into the class list; the Granted Spells table (grantedSpellRows/renderGrantedSpells on the primary spell page) now also auto-lists spells from equipped magic items (DATA.itemSpells, baked from 5etools attachedSpells), racial innate spells (at-will + limited, level-gated), and spell-granting feats (Fey/Shadow Touched), each with source, uses, and the item fixed save DC.

spellcastingBonusElsewhere.note: PARTIAL: item/feat/racial bonus spells now surface standalone in the Granted Spells table (not routed into another class spellcasting feature's countable list)

useDescriptionFull.note: full f.text always used as note

walk.note: walk = the Combat Speed box; fly/swim/climb/burrow render as a dedicated Speeds line in the Combat card (speedExtra state, set from race in applyRace, persisted in save/load). compute() applies the encumbrance/heavy-armor penalty to each mode (Monk Unarmored Movement stays walking-only); legacy 'Other speeds:' Senses lines are stripped on race re-pick.

weaponOptions.note: feature-attack engine (activeFeatureAttacks/syncFeatureAttacks/refreshAtkRows): Dragonborn breath weapon (6 lineages), 10 racial natural weapons (data-driven), + subclass/feat registry (Soulknife, Armorer, Sun Soul, Astral Self, Battlerager, Beast, Fathomless, Polearm Master, Dragon Hide). Magic-item special riders still N/A (no itemText). + magic weapons (concrete + variant templates: Flame Tongue, Frost Brand, Vicious, +N…) and charged items → Limited Features.
